order: Dispatch frozen randomized order; at most three concurrent trials; completion may differ
primary_outcome: Fraction of evaluated generations passing every predefined case, per task and variant. Candidate errors count as failures; missing, infrastructure failures and not-evaluated records excluded and reported.
secondary_outcome: Number of predefined cases passed when runner returns observations. A runtime error aborts the batch; passed-case count is then zero, not a measurement of each preceding case.
wording_intervention: Whole-specification paraphrases in prose, numbered rules, and formal contract; same behavior/bounds/interface, changed wording/order/layout jointly. No algorithm suggestions or asymmetric examples.
extraction: Bare Python or one complete python/py fenced block with no prose; other text parsed unchanged.
metadata_limits: Requested model/effort recorded; backend weights/revision/temperature/seed not observable
Fresh no-history sessions retain system instructions and shared tool/filesystem access
Full candidate tool-event traces unavailable; cannot prove candidates avoided tools or files
Answers copied unchanged from returned first final messages; coordinator observation timestamps only
Candidate interpreter observations are not secure against malicious tampering
analysis: Descriptive counts and within-task pass-rate differences. No significance tests/equivalence claims. Pilot1 vs pilot2 contrast is not causal because tasks and wording intervention changed together.
freeze_policy: Freeze task cases, references, prompts, schedule, protocol, runner and grader before first generation. Keep pilot1 hashes and data intact. Document any later correction separately; no silent outcome-driven changes.
